title: The Common Block
status: Proposed staging boards; board 03 is a rendered proof frame

shots.title: The page becomes a city
shots.action: The ORA site grid, face-on. The camera tilts and the grid becomes a dusk tower façade. Every cell is a room; every room has its own orb, its own colour, its own pulse.
shots.proof: Every employee already has AI — each one differently.
shots.gate: Tower façade instancing; per-room orb clocks.

shots.title: Everyone on their own
shots.action: Inside the rooms: crystals come out in different shapes; one cracks red and is repaired by hand. One document exists in five drifting copies. Coral data threads leave through the windows and fade. Light-level gauges sit low; one dips below the floor.
shots.proof: Scattered knowledge, uneven quality, data leaving unnoticed, efficiency near zero — all visible.
shots.gate: Crystal variants, crack event, thread curves, score-driven gauge columns.

shots.title: The difference is in the foundations
shots.action: Below street level, five slabs fall on the beat. The coral common block hovers, hesitates, and lands with a shockwave. Coral lines run from it to every team.
shots.proof: Something shared and structural sits underneath the work.
shots.gate: RENDERED: proof/ layers.mp4 (15 s) is this shot.

shots.title: One layer reaches everyone
shots.action: Coral lines rise from the common block through every floor. The orbs lock to one pulse and one colour; the crystals come out identical. Every gauge column rises past 100 % and turns green together.
shots.proof: Shared infrastructure → consistent output → efficiency above 100 %.
shots.gate: Vertical tower lines; synchronized orb clock; gauge columns crossing the 100 % mark.

shots.title: One improvement, everywhere
shots.action: One room cuts a better crystal. A pulse travels down into the common block, which reshapes, then up to every room at once.
shots.proof: Optimisers: improvement found once is shared across all teams.
shots.gate: Pulse travel along existing lines; block surface update.

shots.title: Built to be trusted
shots.action: Data threads now curve back into the foundation. Each crystal trails a thread to its source tile. A hand settles on each crystal before it leaves the room.
shots.proof: Data stays yours · every answer has a source · people keep the decision.
shots.gate: Thread routing back into foundation; source tiles; hand gesture.

shots.title: A city on the same foundation
shots.action: Hard pullback. A library of folios, a factory floor, a hotel courtyard light up on the same coral foundation line. A Casablanca-like spire against the sea at dusk.
shots.proof: Knowledger · Blueprint · Backdesk — ready for specific sectors.
shots.gate: Three massing models in the same materials; keep them abstract.

shots.title: ORA
shots.action: Straight-down aerial. Streets straighten into the site grid. The common block seen from above is a coral ring: the O. “RA Ventures” sets beside it. One orb keeps circling.
shots.proof: The company is the foundation underneath everything we just saw.
shots.gate: Wordmark shaping with the site’s display face; top-down camera handoff.
